Today, we released the first version of HDInsight Tools for Visual Studio. With this release, HDInsight users can easily perform tasks directly from Visual Studios, such as creating Hive tables and authoring and submitting Hive queries. To learn more:
  • Getting started documentation
  • Release announcement
